scope: Static ARM control-flow and RTTI evidence in a PlayCueControl track-load path; not full deck execution

selection.retainStoredMain: main != -1 and isAdjusted has bit 0 set
selection.otherwise: derive position from BeatGrid virtual method +0x68, apply main, update default, clear isAdjusted

beatGrid.behavior: Interpolate or extrapolate the selected grid segment at beat coordinate zero; NaN result becomes zero

limitations: Static control-flow evidence, not an executed full deck-load fixture.
Requires valid track/beat-data objects in this path; not a claim about every load source or auto-cue mode.
A stale serialized default may be replaced by a freshly derived grid position.
Source-to-BiteDJ decoder frame alignment remains a separate requirement.
No proprietary decompiled source or firmware is distributed.
